label: Unrestricted free absence with companions gives S2 at w
description: Support for subtraction premise S2 at w from unrestricted free absence (Hume's dictum, absence half) and companions at w. It concludes S2 at w only; the subtraction argument uses S2 throughout the accessible worlds, which the controls derive from the same two premises holding at every accessible world (law 5). Not a transcription: the conclusion's possible absence is extracted from a recombination witness for a chosen companion. Establishes neither premise.
